submitted_fields.style: First eight bars: one soft glassy FM keyboard repeats ONE SINGLE PITCH with identical duration and level, slow even strikes with silence; no melody, chords or accompaniment. Add quiet low bass, then a thin held string-synth chord before the first small two-note hook. Instrumental chip electronica, 126 BPM, 4/4 in B minor, around 4:05. Target a slow Bm - Em vamp, four bars per chord after the opening. Tight machine big-beat drums with a short clap-like snare arrive late. Keep the same 8-bit/16-bit keyboard voice and plain hook throughout, while string voicings grow warmer and drums gain force. Sorrowful but quietly determined. A short middle clears back to the exposed hook and silence; its exact return over full harmony provides the peak. No added lead notes or busy bass variations.
submitted_fields.exclude: vocals, audience noise, busy lead or bass runs, long sixteenth-note arpeggios, competing countermelodies, comic arcade effects, festival drops, intro pitch changes or accompaniment
